description: Delivered two invited lectures in National Training Program on “Weather Based Decision Support System for Crop Risk Management” sponsored by IDP-NAHEP, SKUAST-K on 27th September to 2nd October 2021.
Delivered two invited lectures in online training programme on “Statistical Techniques for Data Analysis in Agriculture” conducted during 04-13th October 2021 at ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi.
Deliver one invited lecture in Winter school training Programme “Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture” on topic “Introduction to ANN & Practical” at ICAR-IASRI on 22nd February 2022.

Delivered four invited lectures in online training programme on “Price forecasting of agricultural commodity” under the NASF project “Leveraging Institutional Innovations for Inclusive and Market led Agricultural Growth in Eastern India” during 21 February to 02 March, 2022 (10 days).

Delivered one invited lecture on training programme for the 43rd Batch of Indian Statistical Service (ISS) probationers (sponsored by National Statistical Systems Training Academy, Central Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and programme Implementation, Government of India) on “Data Analysis and Interpretation” during June 06-17, 2022.

Delivered one invited lecture in Hindi workshop on “बुनियादी सांख्यिकीय तकनीक और आनुवंशिकी में इसका अनुप्रयोग (Basic Statistical Techniques and its applications in Genetics)” from 03-05 August, 2022 at ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi.

Delivered three invited lectures in CAFT training on Prominent Statistical Tools for Data Science in Agriculture using R and Python” for faculty and scientist from 09-29 November, 2022 at ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi.

Delivered one invited lecture in CAFT training on Advances in Statistical Techniques for Efficient Agricultural Experimentation” for faculty and scientist during 11-31st January, 2023 at ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi.
Deliver two invited lectures in Hindi workshop on “"कृषि में सांख्यिकीय और मशीन लर्निंग तकनीक का परिचय"” from 06-12 June, 2023 at ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi.

Deliver invited lecture on “Descriptive Statistics and Exploratory Data Analysis with Hands-on session” held on dated 12/7/2023 in the online training programme on “Analysis of Agricultural Data using Statistical and Data Mining Techniques” organized by Department of Statistics, RVSKVV, Gwalior under NAHEP-IDP in collaboration with NAHEP Component-2 ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi.

Deliver a lecture on the topic “Machine learning and deep learning algorithms in forestry through R studio” on 17.07.23 in 5 days training program on “Data Analytics in Forestry Through R Studio” w.e.f. 12th-18th July 2023 at Faculty of Forestry, Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology of Kashmir (SKUAST-K), Shalimar, Srinagar under ICAR sponsored National Agriculture Higher Education Project (NAHEP).

Deliver a lecture on "Data analysis and interpretation using SPSS" on 24.06.23 in seven days National Level “Faculty Development Programme (FDP)” on “Writing Successful Research Papers and Project Proposals for Funding Agencies”, from 23.06.23 to 30.06.23.

Deliver a lecture on “Python Programming and its application in Data Analytics in big data” an international training course sponsored by Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) for the Foreign Government Officials (35 officials from 35 Countries) on ‘Data Analytics and Risk Management’ from November 20 to December 8, 2023, under prestigious Indian Technical and Economic Cooperation (ITEC) Program, MEA, GOI at IIPA, New Delhi.

Deliver a lecture on “Hybrid Time Series Models” training programme on Advanced Forecasting Techniques in Agriculture Science Research during January 24-February 13, 2024 under the aegis of Centre of Advanced Faculty Training sponsored by Education Division, ICAR, New Delhi at ICRA-IASRI.
Deliver a lecture on “Basic Time Series Models” training programme under the aegis of Centre of Advanced Faculty Training sponsored by Education Division, ICAR, New Delhi at ICRA-NIAP.

Deliver lectures MSc. & Ph.D. students on the topics covering ‘Regression Analysis’ and ‘Statistical Modelling’ as part of the ‘Econometrics’ course at department of Agricultural Economics, Palli Siksha Bhavana, Visva-Bharati from April 15 to April 17, 2025.

Delivered the lecture on 'Survey data analysis using MS-EXCEL' as part of the training program on 'Advances in Survey Research and Data Analysis using Open-Source Software' held on September 22, 2025.

Delivered the lecture on 'Diagnostics and Remedial Measures including Test of Normality/Independence' as part of the training program on 'Use of R for Data Analysis and Visualization' conducted from August 4 to 14, 2025, organized by ICAR-IASRI for Indian Statistical Service (ISS) officer.

Delivered a lecture on "Ensemble Methods for Prediction and Its Applications with Special Emphasis on Agriculture" as part of the Advanced Statistical Modelling and AI/ML Techniques for Precise Forecasting in Agriculture training at ICAR-Indian Agricultural Statistics Research Institute on 22nd January 2026.

Delivered a lecture on "Recurrent Neural Networks and Long-Short-Term-Memory (LSTM) Networks and Their Applications in Agriculture" as part of the Advanced Statistical Modelling and AI/ML Techniques for Precise Forecasting in Agriculture training at ICAR-Indian Agricultural Statistics Research Institute on 23rd January 2026.

Delivered a lecture on "Correlation and Regression Analysis" as part of the ICAR-sponsored Winter School on Modern Data Analytics and Statistical Tools for Smart Experimentation during 29th January to 18th February 2026 on 2nd February 2026.

Delivered a lecture on "Machine Learning Techniques" as part of the ICAR-sponsored Winter School on Modern Data Analytics and Statistical Tools for Smart Experimentation during 29th January to 18th February 2026 on 17th February 2026.

Delivered two lectures on "Introduction to Statistical Software, Descriptive Statistics, and Test of Hypothesis" as part of the One-week Workshop on ‘Artificial Intelligence and Statistical Approaches for Assessing Agricultural Performance’ conducted by the Agro-Economic Research Centre (AERC), Visva-Bharati in collaboration with the Division of Statistical Ecology and Environmental Statistics, ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi from 9th to 13th February 2026 on 11th February 2026.

Delivered two lectures on "Machine Learning Models and Practical on Machine Learning Models" as part of the One-week Workshop on ‘Artificial Intelligence and Statistical Approaches for Assessing Agricultural Performance’ conducted by the Agro-Economic Research Centre (AERC), Visva-Bharati in collaboration with the Division of Statistical Ecology and Environmental Statistics, ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi from 9th to 13th February 2026 on 12th February 2026.

Delivered a lecture on "Multivariate Analysis: Cluster Analysis, Factor Analysis, PCA" as part of the 39th Two-Week National Workshop on the Use of Statistical Tools in ‘R’ for Research & Development at the A.K. Dasgupta Centre for Planning and Development, Visva-Bharati, Santiniketan, on 5th March 2026.

Delivered a lecture on "Advanced Statistical Graphics using R" as part of the 39th Two-Week National Workshop on the Use of Statistical Tools in ‘R’ for Research & Development at the A.K. Dasgupta Centre for Planning and Development, Visva-Bharati, Santiniketan, on 6th March 2026.
